name: Kapolei
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Kapolei, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Kapolei, Hawaii for 2026: Kapolei City Lights, Santa Saturday and Santa at Wet'n'Wild, with dates checked on host sites.
lede: Kapolei celebrates Christmas with Kapolei City Lights at Kapolei Hale, a Santa Saturday carnival at Kapolei Shopping Center and a Hawaiian-style Santa day at Wet'n'Wild Hawaii.
celebrates: Kapolei's Christmas season opens with Kapolei City Lights, the City and County of Honolulu Parks and Recreation celebration at Kapolei Hale. The 2026 theme is Paniolo Nights and Holiday Lights, with a block party and holiday parade on opening night, a 50-foot holiday tree and tree displays from city agencies, Neighborhood Boards and community groups inside the hale. Kapolei Shopping Center adds its Santa Saturday Keiki Carnival, and Wet'n'Wild Hawaii hosts Santa and The Grinch at its waterpark. The decorations stay open to the public through January 3, 2027.
lastyear: Kapolei City Lights returned in 2025 on Saturday, December 6, according to the city's Parks and Recreation page, which calls the celebration a complement to Honolulu City Lights that has been spreading holiday cheer to Leeward Oahu since 2001. The city also streamed the 2025 parade through 'Olelo Community Media and KSSK Radio, and says the full parade can still be watched on YouTube. Kapolei Shopping Center held its Santa Saturday on Saturday, December 7 in 2024, and shares a 2025 photo album on its site.
facts: Kapolei City Lights began in 2001, according to the City and County of Honolulu. The 2026 parade begins at 5:30 pm with the Royal Hawaiian Band launching from Fort Barrette Road and Kapolei Parkway and ends at Kamaaha Avenue. Kapolei Shopping Center says its Santa Saturday has been a community tradition since 1993.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train that runs in Kapolei itself. The Hawaiian Railway Society runs Oahu's only operating historic railway from Ewa Beach to Kahe Point, with pick-up in Ewa Beach or Ko Olina, according to its website. A standard two-hour narrated ride costs $20, and the society's Toy Train Museum is free. The society's 2026 Holiday Express rides are listed as sold out on its site.
train_links: Oahu's only operating historic railway, a two-hour narrated ride from Ewa Beach to Kahe Point.
traditions: The city's holiday decorations and tree displays at Kapolei Hale, open through January 3, 2027.
More than 70 local vendors, live music and a holiday car display around Kapolei Hale.
Over 60 organizations and city departments with decorated vehicles and floats, led by the Royal Hawaiian Band.
Scheduled for 6:15 pm on opening night, according to the city.
Kapolei Shopping Center's free keiki carnival with Santa and Rudolph.
kidfact: The Kapolei Hale tree is a 50-foot holiday tree, and Kapolei City Lights has been lighting it since 2001.
faq: Kapolei City Lights is the main event. The City and County of Honolulu opens it with a block party, parade and Mayor's Tree Lighting at Kapolei Hale, then keeps the decorations open to the public through January 3. Kapolei Shopping Center adds a free Santa Saturday carnival in early December.
When do the Kapolei City Lights decorations open?

The decorations open the evening of Saturday, November 28, 2026 and stay open through Sunday, January 3, 2027. Hours are Monday to Thursday 7:30 am to 8 pm, Fridays 7:30 am to 10 pm, and weekends and holidays 10 am to 10 pm.
Is there a Christmas parade in Kapolei?

Yes. The Kapolei City Lights holiday parade starts at 5:30 pm on November 28 from Fort Barrette Road and Kapolei Parkway and ends at Kamaaha Avenue. It features more than 60 organizations and is free to watch.
Can kids meet Santa in Kapolei?

Yes. Kapolei City Lights opening night includes pictures with Santa, and Kapolei Shopping Center's Santa Saturday on December 5 offers free photos. Wet'n'Wild Hawaii lists photos with Santa and The Grinch at its December 19 event.
sources: City and County of Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kapolei for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Kapolei City Lights: Paniolo Nights & Holiday Lights) through January 3, with the Santa Saturday Keiki Carnival at Kapolei Shopping Center (December 5) and Santa & Friends Hawaiian Wonderland at Wet'n'Wild Hawaii (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kapolei

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Kapolei
  • 2 free events: Kapolei City Lights and the Santa Saturday Keiki Carnival at Kapolei Shopping Center
  • Meet Santa: Santa Saturday Keiki Carnival (December 5), pictures with Santa on Kapolei City Lights opening night, and Santa & Friends at Wet'n'Wild Hawaii (December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Kapolei City Lights holiday parade and Mayor's Tree Lighting on November 28
  • Trains: none in town; the nearest is the Hawaiian Railway Society in Ewa Beach
  • Season: November 28 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Kapolei families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Honolulu, which covers Honolulu City Lights, The Nutcracker at Blaisdell, How the Grinch Stole Christmas at Diamond Head Theatre and weekly Santa photos at Royal Hawaiian Center.
